description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a large light-colored pillow is in front, with a white charging cable coiled near the center and a smartphone off to the right. The right hand lifts the phone and brings it toward the cable while the left hand picks up the cable’s connector; the left hand guides the plug into the phone’s port as the right hand steadies it, then the right hand sets the now-connected phone down on the bed and releases.
